question: Does giving each persistent latent a private final actor projection preserve the confirmed SAPPO repertoire's complementary payoff structure while retaining a shared observation encoder and actor trunk?

authorization.required_case: B4.1: crossover FAIL, retention PASS, identity PASS

hypothesis_and_causal_boundary.hypothesis: With assigned-pole optimization already fixed, destructive interference in the fully shared final actor representation may prevent z0 and z1 from preserving complementary payoff specialization.
hypothesis_and_causal_boundary.boundary: EXP2B makes shared-actor interference a leading hypothesis but does not prove it. EXP2C is the prospective controlled ablation designed to test it.
hypothesis_and_causal_boundary.if_pass: A minimal private final actor projection restored complementary payoff specialization under otherwise unchanged shared-policy compression.
hypothesis_and_causal_boundary.if_fail: Mode-specific final projections were insufficient. Stop latent architecture experimentation, forbid EXP2D, request PI direction, and preserve the negative result for paper framing.

proposed_preset_review.scientific_delta_plain_english: Replace EXP2B's one shared final actor projection with one final linear projection per latent mode. Keep the observation encoder and actor body shared and trainable.
proposed_preset_review.reason_new_experiment_is_required: EXP2B validly failed after removing cross-pole assignment pressure. Existing EXP2/EXP2B cannot test whether the final shared actor projection is the remaining interference point.
proposed_preset_review.preset_policy: No paper-faithful preset may be changed or relabeled. Prefer an experiment-scoped default-off config field. If a registry preset is added during implementation, complete the repository Proposed Preset Review and registry update before launch.
proposed_preset_review.snapshot_policy: No existing preset snapshot may change. Regenerate snapshots only if an intentional new preset entry requires it and document the additive diff.

single_scientific_delta.EXP2B: one shared Linear(hidden_dim, action_dim) action_head for z0 and z1
single_scientific_delta.EXP2C: ModuleList of exactly K=2 Linear(hidden_dim, action_dim) action heads selected by persistent z
single_scientific_delta.initialization: both private heads are copied exactly from the ordinary shared action head before the first optimizer step
single_scientific_delta.shared_path: actor CNN/local encoder and complete actor body remain shared and trainable
single_scientific_delta.critic: unchanged shared centralized scalar critic conditioned on z
forbidden_private_capacity: private actor body or deep branch trunk
two independent PPO models or optimizers
single_scientific_delta.required_resolved_diff: Against EXP2B, the only scientific config change is a default-off EXP2C mode-specific-final-head flag false -> true. Run identity, artifact paths, fresh seed, and protocol path may also differ.

frozen_shared_contract.model: one shared policy object and one checkpoint
frozen_shared_contract.z_lifetime: static per environment and persistent for the full episode
frozen_shared_contract.opponent_identity_input: FORBIDDEN in actor, critic, latent assignment, and teacher routing
frozen_shared_contract.teacher_objective: lambda * KL(teacher || student) on the student's mapped z head with identical legal-action masking
frozen_shared_contract.teacher_cadence: one teacher update per four completed PPO actor minibatch updates; floor rule, no trailing update
frozen_shared_contract.PPO: exact EXP2B PPO architecture outside the final projection, optimizer, rollout, discounting, GAE, entropy/value coefficients, normalization, observation pipeline, reward and M1 ruleset
frozen_shared_contract.checkpoint_policy: terminal checkpoint only; no intermediate selection
frozen_shared_contract.claim_boundary: supervised latent repertoire compression, not unsupervised or label-free latent discovery

required_invariants: exactly two private final heads exist and share no parameter storage
both heads receive PPO and mapped teacher gradients only from their selected z rows
shared CNN/body receives gradients from both modes
no private adapter or deep branch exists
z stays fixed for each episode
teacher-to-PPO cadence invariant holds at every update

observational_gradient_telemetry.preserve_EXP2B_metric: cosine(g_z0_A, g_z1_B) over shared actor parameters only
observational_gradient_telemetry.execution: observational only; no optimizer step, parameter mutation, .grad accumulation, optimizer-state mutation, or RNG perturbation

bootstrap.procedure: paired percentile bootstrap over seed-level episode outcomes

behavioral_action_identity.matched_state_source: all decision-eligible local observations from all eight terminal evaluation cells

gates.trajectory_reporting: same preregistered EXP2/EXP2B telemetry, descriptive only and unable to rescue a failed primary gate
gates.overall_pass: all crossover, retention, behavioral-identity, provenance, and runtime gates pass

required_before_step_1: resolved config diff against EXP2B proves the mode-specific-final-head flag is the only scientific delta
existing paper-faithful preset snapshots and concat-only contracts remain unchanged
unit tests prove exactly two private final heads and a shared CNN/body
identity initialization proves both private heads equal the ordinary shared head before training
gradient routing proves z0 rows cannot update z1 head and z1 rows cannot update z0 head
integrated teacher smoke proves z0 KL to pi_A and z1 KL to pi_B decrease
live smoke proves 16/0/0/16, persistent z, M1 overlays, correct teacher hashes, lambda=.1 and 1:4 cadence
resume/checkpoint tests preserve both private heads and treatment counters
telemetry makes a silent shared-head fallback impossible
fresh seed blocks re-audit CLEAN with reservation records excluded
production run directory does not exist

forbidden_after_any_development_or_evalu: changing private-head depth, width, count, initialization, or placement
adding adapters, private trunks, private critics, diversity losses, or new objectives
changing K, lambda, cadence, teacher mapping, assignment, budget, checkpoint, gates, bootstrap, or seed block
rerunning because the result is unattractive
one_attempt_rule.invalid_run_exception: Only a fail-fast provenance, plumbing, or runtime invariant can invalidate a run before scoring. The identical frozen scientific configuration may relaunch only after a typed invalid-run record and engineering fix.
one_attempt_rule.valid_fail: Freeze and commit; stop latent architecture experimentation, forbid EXP2D, keep EXP3/EXP4 locked, and request PI direction.
